components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-emphasis action for progressing or saving.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--brand); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--paper); background: var(--brand); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-dark); border-color: var(--brand-dark); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82a2ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered companion action for cancel, back and lower-emphasis choices.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--canvas); border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82a2ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive action reserved for deletion and other irreversible operations.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--danger); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--paper); background: var(--danger); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-dark); border-color: var(--danger-dark); } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82a2ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The standard labeled text entry pattern used throughout account and assessment forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .45rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 680; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: .7rem .8rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 9px; font: inherit; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: #8792a5; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82a2ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--danger); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--danger); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact semantic label for readiness, completion and review states.
components.html: ReadyCompleteReview
components.css: .ds-status-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .75rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; min-height: 28px; padding: .2rem .6rem; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--brand); background: var(--brand-soft); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 760; } .ds-status-pass { color: var(--success); background: var(--success-soft); } .ds-status-review { color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-soft); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The default bordered paper surface for forms, lists and dashboard content.
components.html:
Recent exams

3 available
Choose an assessment when you are ready to begin.
components.css: .ds-panel { color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .ds-panel-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.25rem 1.4rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-panel-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-panel-meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: .86rem; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 1.4rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: The sticky application header with a restrained brand mark and clearly underlined current route.
components.html:
ExamFlow
OverviewExamsStudents
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 68px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; padding: 0 1rem; color: var(--ink); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .96); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: -.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; color: var(--paper); background: var(--brand); border-radius: 11px; } .ds-brand-mark svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; } .ds-nav-link { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 620; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82a2ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-current { color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--brand); }

components.name: Exam Answer Option
components.description: The large, explicit radio choice used in the focused timed-exam workspace.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; gap: .8rem; align-items: flex-start; padding: 1rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 11px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-weight: 520; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: var(--brand); background: var(--brand-soft); } .ds-option:has(.ds-option-radio:checked) { border-color: var(--brand); background: var(--brand-soft); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--brand); } .ds-option-radio { width: 20px; min-height: 20px; margin: .12rem 0 0; accent-color: var(--brand); } .ds-option-radio:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82a2ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Question Palette Button
components.description: The numbered question navigator with current and answered states.
components.css: .ds-palette { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 44px); gap: .5rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-palette-button { aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-palette-button:hover { border-color: var(--brand); } .ds-palette-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82a2ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-palette-current { color: var(--paper); background: var(--brand); border-color: var(--brand); } .ds-palette-answered:not(.ds-palette-current) { color: var(--success); background: var(--success-soft); border-color: #80b99e; }

narrative.overview:
ExamFlow feels like a quiet proctor: present, legible and disciplined without competing with the work. Deep ink frames important moments, white paper surfaces hold the task, and a decisive blue makes actions and current state unmistakable.

The interface is compact but breathable. Fine borders organize routine information; selective shadow lifts only the few surfaces that need attention. Semantic color appears as concise feedback, while the timed examination workspace removes the general application chrome and keeps the question, remaining time and navigation in view.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ink anchors with restrained blue emphasis
Clear task hierarchy and minimal visual noise
Purposeful feedback for progress, success, review and danger

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use blue for action and current selection; reserve amber, red and green for semantic outcomes.

rules.name: The Paper-on-Canvas Rule
rules.body: Routine work sits on white surfaces over the cool canvas, separated by borders before shadow.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Keep interface copy in sentence case; uppercase is reserved for compact table headers.

rules.name: The Stable Numbers Rule
rules.body: Timers, scores and metric values use tabular figures so changing values do not shift the layout.

rules.name: The Bounded Workspace Rule
rules.body: Keep general work inside the `1180px` frame and grant the timed exam extra width only for its question-and-navigator split.

rules.name: The Selective Lift Rule
rules.body: Start with a fine border; add shadow only when a surface is transient, focused or intentionally presented.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Larger containers use the `14px` surface radius; controls inside them step down to `8px-11px` so hierarchy remains visible.

dos: Do use Decisive Blue for primary actions and current state.
Do preserve the `44px` button and `46px` field minimum heights for dependable interaction.
Do use borders and tonal contrast to organize routine panels before adding shadow.
Do keep the timer, score and metric values stable with tabular figures.
Do preserve visible focus and the reduced-motion fallback on every core workflow.
donts: Don't use semantic amber, red or green as decorative accents.
Don't turn large routine surfaces blue; Deep Ink and Paper White carry the main structure.
Don't add elevation to every panel or table row.
Don't hide the native exam selection control or make answer state depend on color alone.
Don't retain multi-column tables, forms or workspaces when the established responsive breakpoints stack them.
